title: Ngā Kaitiaki o te Māra
intro: I roto i tētahi māra matomato, i oati tetahi hapori i tētahi mea tapu. Engari i whakamatautauria tō rātou whakatau i te wā i uru mai ai te whakaaro o te Atua, ā, i hurihia ō rātou hua hei whenua pakoko.
clues: I manaakitia mātou ki tētahi māra momona, engari i whakakake mātou.
I whakatakoto mātou i tētahi mahere hei hauhake, engari kāore i tua atu ki te hunga rawakore.
I haere wawe mātou i te atatu, me te whakapono ki tā mātou mahere.
I tō mātou taenga atu, i kitea kua whakangaromia tā mātou māra i te pō kotahi.
I kite māua i tā māua hapa, ā, ka tīmata māua te whakapae tetahi i tetahi.
I ripeneta mātou i te mutunga, engari kua roa rawa te wā i akohia ai te akoranga.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: He māra kua huri hei pungarehu
He waipuke i whakangaro i ngā mea katoa
I pā te matekai ki te whenua
He ope manu e whakaeke ana
He hau nui i hutia ngā rākau
trial.answer: He māra kua huri hei pungarehu

outcome.label: Hua
options: I ripeneta rātou engari i ngaro tā rātou māra
I whakaorangia rātou e te whakapono
outcome.answer: I ripeneta rātou engari i ngaro tā rātou māra

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
